s: Warner-Lambert Company originated in 1856 as a drugstore in Philadelphia. Through acquisitions and mergers over many decades, it grew into a large transnational pharmaceutical company with sales in over 130 countries by 1991. By 1990, Warner-Lambert had three core business segments: ethical pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter healthcare products, and confectionery products.
